title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ReplicationPolicy
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ReplicationPolicy. Describes data protection features based on replication for storage services. Subclass of DataProtectionPolicy per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the DataProtectionPolicy model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ReplicationPolicy'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

synchronousReplication.description: Property. Whether replication is performed in synchronous mode.

consistencyType.description: Property. Type of consistency supported. Controlled-vocabulary value (ConsistencyType), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

replicaNumber.description: Property. How many independent copies are made.

geoReplication.description: Property. Scope of geo-replication: cross-region, cross-dc, or cross-az. Controlled-vocabulary value (GeoReplicationScope), enumeration not resolved in this pass.
